name: linkedin-agent
description: Eleven Claude skills and a six-agent team that run a LinkedIn account: a strategist (plan, audit, profile), a writer (posts off 21 hook formulas, carousels, repurposing), a web designer (banners, carousel PDFs, landing pages), an engager (comments, replies), outreach (DMs, inbox triage) and an editor running a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint and scores every draft before it goes out.
